integrity: The 2026 public full text was inspected at the transform definition, specialized CDF/PDF, survival/hazard, moments, quantile section, likelihood, conclusions, and reference to the 2024 generator. The 2024 open full text was inspected at the general new weighted sine-G CDF/PDF. The correction is proved by direct differentiation and exact normalization; high-precision integration is only a check.
scientific_limitations: The finding proves a formula-level CDF/PDF inconsistency but does not reconstruct the implementation used for every numerical table.
Numerical results computed with a corrected derivative density may survive even though the printed formulas are inconsistent.
No independent re-estimation of the real-data applications is claimed.
title: The published WSG-Kumaraswamy density is not normalized
